record: House of Councillors National Diet Building guide
facts: The main building was completed in November 1936. Published size is 206.36 m north to south and 88.63 m east to west. The main roof is 20.91 m high and the central tower is 65.45 m.

record: House of Councillors building exterior guide
facts: The building is steel-reinforced concrete with an exterior of high-quality Japanese granite.
The center has four storeys and the central tower nine. The two wings have three storeys, and their chamber areas are equal.
